name: Compounder StrategyDAICurve permissionless deposit manipulation
summary: StrategyDAICurve let anyone call deposit(), which added its loose DAI to the thin Curve y pool as yDAI with zero minimum output, and valued its yyCRV through the same pool's spot quote. The attacker unbalanced the pool, cycled DAI through the cVault and the strategy, forced deposit() and reversed the Curve trades for profit.
notes: The cVault paid the attacker through controller.strategies(DAI) and this strategy's balanceOf; the controller's setStrategy, 30 minutes after deployment, made that route, so it is the reset.

Loss is the cVault's net DAI outflow (attacker deposits netted). The yDAI/yyCRV position the strategy bought with the forced deposit is an asset gain not subtracted; the attacker's own net was 27,146.69 DAI.
